WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT oa.*,
         b.avg_net_fee_rate AS benchmark_rate
  FROM order_averages oa
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE oa.avg_net_fee_rate > b.avg_net_fee_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rebate) AS avg_order_avg_rebate,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS avg_order_avg_net_fee_rate,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate - benchmark_rate) AS avg_excess_net_fee_rate
FROM above_benchmark;

assumptions.assumption: Orders are grouped by orderslink as specified; NULL orderslink values are grouped together as one no-order group. Each final average skips NULL order-level values, and the benchmark averages non-NULL fee-level net rates.
